# Codex runtime reuse

Runtime: official `@openai/codex` **0.154.0**, locked by `apps/desktop/package-lock.json`. Windows platform package metadata declares Apache-2.0. The native runtime remains unmodified. Public upstream LICENSE/NOTICE were retrieved on 2026-10-02; npm integrity pins the actual runtime archive independently of the upstream main branch.

The small Windows binary resolver in `scripts/office-agent/codex-runtime.mjs` adapts the platform resolution from the installed official CLI wrapper. JSONL smoke glue does not implement an agent loop. Experimental protocol types are generated by the locked executable, rather than inferred from online examples.

Windows x64 native package unpacked size: 398,574,236 bytes per npm metadata. It includes the main runtime, code mode helper, ripgrep, command runner and sandbox setup program. Sandbox setup is not invoked by these proofs. Package the full vendor directory and this license/notice outside Electron asar under `resources/codex`; preserve helper layout. Updates require a new exact lock, protocol generation and capability/recovery acceptance. No automatic global CLI upgrade.

Current proof scripts are local acceptance drivers; desktop production integration and installer acceptance are tracked separately.
